status: Same-formula control comparison; known-label method development only

comparison.interpretation: Pair values share trajectories and are not independent observations. Only six independently prepared trajectories exist; descriptive method-development comparison, no calibrated significance or efficacy inference.

limits: Same formula/mass/solvent count reduce size and concentration confounds, but shape, stereochemistry and exposed surface differ.
Liquid-water hydration is not ice-binding, IRI, apoptosis, toxicity or cell-viability prediction.
Known experimental labels remain contextual and are not used to fit or select models.
Neither physical convergence nor a cryoprotective mechanism is established by passing these engineering flags.
